cases.fixture: asymmetric existing makeup on a consenting adult portrait
cases.expect: person-relative left and right independent for all four controls; unlock preserves values; explicit relink never copies or averages

cases.fixture: same photo reopened, reanalysed, creative source changed, source-alias document
cases.expect: immutable support survives only exact owner; stale landmarks/source rejected; alias document mutation refused

cases.fixture: bare eye, vivid shadow, neutral shadow, iris or eyelashes alone
cases.expect: no semantic detection claim; user-reviewed bare skin is not ground truth; no automatic no-makeup identity claim; globe/lash/brow protected

cases.fixture: two matched bare-skin patches, one missing, contradictory patches, specular or deep shadow patches
cases.expect: overall positive/negative accepts only estimable agreeing patches; no fake makeup removal; subcontrols independent

cases.fixture: visible makeup with pores and fine granules plus broad shading
cases.expect: low/mid-scale correction preserves fine source residual rather than pixel blur; verify no halos or banding before accepting

cases.fixture: glasses, bangs, long lashes, occluded eye, overlapping other face, severe profile, crop
cases.expect: explicit exclusion and measured safety guards; refuse insufficient support, never invent hidden skin

cases.fixture: RGB16 PNG, opaque SDR JPEG, alpha PNG, HDR float input
cases.expect: RGB16 source low bits preserved through float32 solve and 16-bit export; alpha/HDR refused by owner without flattening or clipping

cases.fixture: preview and export of original/derived effective source, edge-crossing tiles
cases.expect: prepare source field once for each render grid; tile only crops frozen delta; no tiling seams, no proxy-mask enlargement

cases.fixture: near-gamut existing coloured makeup and upstream colour edits
cases.expect: finite SDR output through common-direction feasibility, no per-channel clipping, zero/protected exact bits

cases.fixture: rapid repeated buttons, pending and uncertain receipts, new source, owner revision, Close/Reopen, late PNG load
cases.expect: one canonical request; query original uncertain request, no replay; old draft cannot commit after binding changes; callback identity alone does not invalidate draft

cases.fixture: cancel during snapshot, integral preparation, solve, validation
cases.expect: no partial native output, no partial LocalEffect or history publication; old result preserved

cases.fixture: huge source, thin makeup region, tiny eye, oversized vector or neighbour budget
cases.expect: clear refusal before image-sized allocations where possible, no downsample/radius fallback
